entry.title: New: opencues#integrations-dsh
entry.summary: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key. Exact install spec: @opencues/dsh. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
